method_note: Quadrants = LST/building-age terciles among cells with both data (2026). 'Significant' here = a simplified spatial-contiguity heuristic (>=3 of 8 neighbors share the same extreme quadrant), NOT a permutation-based Bivariate Local Moran's I -- that is the documented next step (see esda/libpysal in the project notes) once there is time to verify it properly.
